segments.text: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

footnotes.text: + waited…: Heb. expected Job in words

segments.text: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

footnotes.text: + left…: Heb. removed speeches from themselves

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

footnotes.text: + spirit…: Heb. spirit of my belly

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

segments.speaker: Elihu
segments.text: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
